# SLOP011 font-not-shipped

## What it does

Flags a literal `font-family` or `--font-*` whose first family is not a generic or system face and that no `@font-face` defines. A project that loads fonts through Google Fonts, Bunny, `next/font` or `@fontsource` is exempt, as is a `[decisions] fonts` project. Warn.

## Why it matters

A font that is named but never loaded silently renders as the system stack.

## Remedy

Ship the font with `@font-face` or a loader, or name a system face.

## Examples

### A named font with no @font-face fires

```css expect=fire file=styles/app.css
body {
  font-family: Gotham, sans-serif;
}
```

### A shipped font is clean

```css expect=clean file=styles/app.css
@font-face {
  font-family: Gotham;
  src: url(gotham.woff2);
}
body {
  font-family: Gotham, sans-serif;
}
```

### A system stack is clean

```css expect=clean file=styles/app.css
body {
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
}
```

### A loader import is clean

```css expect=clean file=styles/app.css
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gotham");
body {
  font-family: Gotham, sans-serif;
}
```

### A declared fonts decision is clean

```css expect=clean file=styles/app.css config=decide-fonts
body {
  font-family: Gotham, sans-serif;
}
```
